{{dablink|For the chapter in ''[[The Path of Daggers]]'' by a similar name, see ''[[The Path of Daggers/Chapter 28|Crimsonthorn]]''.}}
'''Crimsonthorn root''' is an [[herb]] described as being white and having a rather sweet taste to it. It is a good painkiller in small doses. In large quantities it kills more than just pain by slowly paralyzing muscles and causing asphyxia. [[Adeleas Namelle]] and [[Ispan Shefar]] found this out first-hand the paralyzing nature of crimsonthorn root.{{ref/book|8|28}} No antidote is known for a strong dose.
